type_name: A label that defines the generalised category of an asset, based on shared characteristics or function.
asset_area_id: The unique id of the asset area generated by DKG.
last_modified_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the asset was modified the last time in the metadata source.
status_code: The numeric number of the status of the asset in dkg for sorting.
ingestion_time: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the asset was ingested into DKG.
type_id: The globally unique id of the asset type, generated by DKG using uuidv5.
metadata_source_name: The source system where the asset was created.
last_modified_by: The unique id of the user in the metadata source who modified the asset the last time. If missing, metadata source name is used.
display_name: The display name that will be used in UIs, e.g., marketplace, in title case.
created_by: The unique id of the user in the metadata source who created the asset. If missing, metadata source name is used.
asset_source_id: The unique id of the asset in the metadata source.
status_display_name: The display name of the status of the asset in the metadata source.
created_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the asset was created in the metadata source.
asset_source_url: The unique address of the asset to the metadata source.
name: The default name of the asset used in metadata source.
asset_area_name: A descriptive identifier for a group of assets, typically indicating what they are about or governing entity.
id: The globally unique id of the asset generated by DKG using uuidv5.
metadata_source_id: The unique id of the metadata source generated by DKG.
